header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH AT KARACHI
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE(S).
1. For orders on CMA No.8203/2026 (If granted).
2. For orders on office objection No.2 & 3 at flag “A”.
Mr. Muhammad Vawda, Advocate for the Petitioner.
2-5. After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for
body: the petitioner submits that he does not press this petition, provided that the petitioner’s pending application under Section 11 of the Domestic Violence Act, 2013, is directed to be decided expeditiously by the learned trial Court, where the matter is already fixed for hearing on 07.11.2026.

In view of the above statement, this petition is disposed of as not pressed, with a direction to the learned XVIIIth Judicial Magistrate, Karachi South, before whom the proceedings are pending, to decide the petitioner’s application under Section 11 of the aforesaid Act, strictly in accordance with law, after providing an opportunity of hearing to all concerned, within ten (10) days from the date of receipt of this order. It is clarified that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the matter, which shall be decided independently on the basis of the material available on record.

The petition stands disposed of in the above terms, along with all pending applications. A copy of this order shall be communicated to the learned trial Court for information and compliance. JUDGE Ayaz Gul
